name: dual_range
title: Dual Range
description: A slider with two thumbs for picking a minimum and a maximum, built from two native range inputs.

classes.name: dual-range
classes.description: Wraps exactly two <input type="range">: the minimum first, the maximum second.

variables.name: --dual-range-thumb-active-color
variables.description: Thumb color while dragged or focused.

variables.name: --dual-range-fill-color
variables.description: Color of the selected part of the track.

attributes.name: data-dual-range-target="min"
attributes.description: The minimum. Give both inputs the same min, max and step.

attributes.name: data-dual-range-precision
attributes.description: Decimal places used for the internal midpoint. Defaults to 3.

notes: Both inputs are submitted as normal form fields. Listen for input or change events on them to react to changes.
The script narrows each input's own min or max to the midpoint, so read the overall range from the first input's min and the second input's max.
This replaces css-zero's wrapper around @stanko/dual-range-input; the library is no longer needed.
